title: Crispy British Chicken Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, featuring crispy fried chicken and served with a side of salsa and avocado.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, ultimate seasoning, and british skillet seasoning.
Pour buttermilk into a separate shallow dish.
Dredge chicken breasts in flour mixture, then dip in buttermilk, and finally coat in flour mixture again.
Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry chicken breasts until golden brown and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing fried chicken onto a tortilla, topping with shredded cheese, and serving with salsa and avocado on the side.
